title: Characters dancing to the music
description: Make characters hop, squash and swing their limbs on the beat of whatever song is playing, and stomp up dust, tap drums or play footsteps on each landing. Component: 3d/godot/world_life/beat_dance.gd (world-life module). Derived from ShammyVerse.

optional_ai: Wiring the component into the game; a person reviews the result in play.

stages.title: Vendor the world-life module
stages.description: Copy the kit and components into the game with a SHA-256 lock per file.

stages.title: Wire the component
stages.description: Game code: `tools/song_beats.py --song id=path … --out <game>/song_beats.gd` writes each song's tempo and first-beat offset (a GDScript constant always exports). The game's root node calls `KIT.set_beat(BEATS, song_id, song_seconds)` every frame. In music videos the recorder adapter's `_beat_clock(t)` calls `KIT.song_clock(id, t)` so dances follow the video. Add `beat_dance.gd` under each dancer: `body`, optional `limbs` (arms then legs), `hop_height`, `beats_per_hop`, and `phase_offset` to stagger a group. Connect `stomped(at)` to dust puffs, drum taps (`KIT.tone`) or footsteps.

stages.title: Test
stages.description: Headless test on a fixed clock (the GameCore component test, plus the game's own).

checks.title: Stomp signal fires once per hop

stages.title: Review in play
stages.description: The requester reviews the result in play or in a showcase shot; notes go to the design log.

checks.title: Landings coincide with the song's beat (watch with sound)
